name: My Kingdom for a Horse
summary: A nearby farm has lost its horses, leaving Stormwind without cavalry for its campaign against the Horde. You are sent to Wheeler’s Grange to speak with Benjy.

sections.title: The Missing Stock
sections.body: Stormwind’s warhorses come from two nearby farms, but Wheeler’s Grange has lost all of its stock. The cause is unknown, and without horses the city has no cavalry for its campaign against the Horde. You are sent to speak with Benjy at the grange and learn what he has to say.

faq.q: Why does Stormwind need the horses?
faq.answer: Stormwind relies on warhorses for its cavalry, which it considers necessary for its campaign against the Horde.

faq.q: What happened to the horses at Wheeler’s Grange?
faq.answer: All of the Wheeler family’s stock is missing, and the cause is unknown.
Benjy is at Wheeler’s Grange, where you are sent to ask about the missing horses.
Stormwind’s warhorses come from two nearby farms. The Wheeler family owns one of them, Wheeler’s Grange.
